name: checkout-sign-in-choice
title: Checkout sign-in choice
description: The fork before checkout: sign in, or continue as a guest with just an email, with what an account adds stated plainly.
docs: Two cards side by side, stacked on a phone with the guest card first; side by side they share their rows, so the headings and the first fields line up whatever the length of the descriptions. onSignIn receives { email, password } once both are filled in, and onContinueAsGuest receives the guest's email: return, or resolve to, a sentence when it fails ('That email and password do not match.') and it is shown in an announced alert in that card; return nothing when it worked. Each form checks itself when it is sent, writes the problem under the field and moves focus there. providers is a slot under the sign-in form after an 'or' rule, for a passkey or an email link. forgotHref shows the forgot link beside the password; createAccountHref (a link) or onCreateAccount (a button) is the way to an account, under a list of what an account adds (benefits, three read best). defaultEmail starts the sign-in with a known address. headingAs is h1 by default; the cards' titles sit one level below, and each card is a labelled region. labels holds every word.
